steps.text: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C). Grease a 12-cup muffin tin or line cups with paper liners.

Whisk flour, sugar, baking soda, and baking powder together in a bowl. Stir in bananas, mayonnaise, and chocolate chips until well combined. Spoon batter into the prepared muffin cups, filling each about 3/4 full.
Bake in the preheated oven until golden and tops spring back when lightly pressed, about 20 minutes.

raw_recipe.headline: Moist Banana Muffins
raw_recipe.description: This recipe for moist banana muffins includes mayonnaise, bananas, chocolate chips, flour, sugar, baking powder, and baking soda for the moistest muffins.

review.reviewBody: This one is A KEEPER! I have been searching for the perfect banana bread/muffin recipe for years, and I have finally found it. For those of you who may be thinking "Mayonnaise! What???" do not fear, there is no residual mayonnaise taste in these muffins whatsoever. If you think about it, mayo is really just egg whites and vinegar, which often appear together in cake recipes. And these are very cake-y indeed. Even my banana-phobic brother in law couldn't get enough of these. Also, to the reviewer who found the recipe not liquid-y enough, something must have gone horribly wrong. You do have to make sure that you choose bananas that are past their prime, they'll break down into liquid and sugar better/faster. Also, the mayo makes this recipe a little more "sticky" than the typical quickbread batter. Just go with it, you won't be sorry.

These are the best banana muffins I've ever made! I added 1 tbsp vanilla, decreased the sugar to about 3/4 cup, let the batter sit for 15 min, then filled my muffin tins up full so this only made 8 for me, but then baked them at 425 for the first 7 min, decreased to 350 for 18 min and they came out perfect!

They are awesome!! I added some chopped walnuts, a pinch of salt, and 1 tsp. of vanilla. Have made them often and they are great every time. I use the bite-sized muffin tins and cook them for a few minutes less.

Every time I make banana bread it always comes out dry. While searching I made sure I added moist to the banana bread search. I came across this recipe and was was intrigued because of the mayo. Unfortunately, I didn’t have tin liners and actually wanted a loaf. I used a 9x5 loaf dish. Started the temp at 325, cooked for an hour. Wasn’t close to being done so I turned the heat up to 350 and cooked for another half hour or so. Needless to say, I will be using this recipe again. I didn’t have quite enough mayo so I added some water to the container and it’s still good. Can’t wait to try it with a full cup. I also went with some other reviews and added much lived vanilla and cinnamon. Can’t wait for the family to try it and love it. Then I’ll tell the about the mayo! Thank you for the moist banana nut bread. Oh yeah, got to have walnuts in it

My family loves this recipe. Perfect as it is written. When we have fresh pumpkin in the fall, i double the recipe and substitute the banana with 4 C fresh pumpkin. Added 1.5 tsp pumpkin spice seasoning, and baked in a 13x9 pan. Worked out great.

I made some minor alterations to this recipe to adjust to my families palate. First I always double my recipes so I added 2 large mashed avocados as well as 6 small bananas & in the mashed mixture I added I added 4 tablespoons cocoa powder & 1 tablespoon of ground cardamom seeds. Once I mixed all the ingredients together I added 4 tablespoons of hazelnut flavored instant coffee granules....also most of my kids don't fancy advocados so I sneak them in...I can't always hide the green fruit but I enhances the nutritional content & the coffee & cocoa flavors occupy the muffin

Moist and delicious! Yield: 18 average sized muffins.
At 6,237 ft. altitude, so I adjusted recipe as follows: increased baking temp. 25 degrees, decreased baking powder by 1/4 tsp, reduced sugar by 2 TBSP, added extra mashed banana and 1 tsp vanilla. 
Rose beautifully baked in small side oven in EKCO 8 muffin pan, while those baked in main oven in two Chilton Ware 6 muffin pans did not rise as well. (Pan difference and/or check temp. accuracy?)

I decided that I would experiment by subbing 1/2 cup of sourdough starter in place of 1/2 cup of the flour. Since the recipe doesn’t contain additional liquid, I assumed the liquid in the starter would be beneficial. I also added a t of good cinnamon(the real Ceylon type) and a pinch of salt. I mixed the Mayo into the banana and then mixed in the dry ingredients. They are quite delicate right out of the tin.

I have been looking for an amazing banana muffin/bread recipe for over 20 years. This is it! I sometimes use white sugar, sometimes brown sugar, or a mix. 
This recipe is tender, flavourful and amazing! There is no taste of mayo, which is made of eggs and vegetable oil. 
I always throw in an extra half banana per recipe. Then it comes out perfectly. 
This has been my go to for over a year. And everyone comments how good they are!

I was skeptical about the mayo in this recipe but I decided to give it a whirl. I added 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon, a teaspoon of vanilla and subbed 3/4 brown sugar for the white as I also added an extra banana for natural sweetness because it was rotting in the fruit bowl. They are AMAZING!!! 
I can truthfully say these are the most tender crumb I have ever had for banana muffins. Mayo wins

I am allergic to wheat and dairy. I used Bob's Red Mill 1 to 1 gf flour. These are hands down the BEST muffins I have EVER made. Even before my special diet when I baked all the time. I add chocolate chips. So easy and totally delicious. I usually only try 4.5-5 star recipes. These are 5 star for a reason!

I made 1 1/2 times the recipe and got 12 jumbo muffins. I did add a teaspoon of banana flooring and substituted golden raisins for the chocolate chips because I didn't have any chips. Sprinkled the tops with a mixture of brown sugar, cinnamon, chopped pecans, and Baker's white sugar. Easy to put together and cleanup. Yum!

Moist & delicious. I used about 3/4 cup sugar instead of 1 cup. Was still sweet with great flavor. Next time I'll try 1/2 cup sugar. Chocolate chips went great with the banana. Definitely making again! 😋
Easy to make with ripe uneaten bananas
Yummm
Delicious! I used Splenda to replace sugar. Added chopped pecans to mix then added a full one on top before baking!
I think my bananas were too ripe
The best out there.
easy to make
